description: polar comparison of ML interatomic potentials: NEP and DeepMD vs an ab initio (DFT) reference WITH polarizability (polar=true, polar_force=true). One cavity mode near the CO2 asymmetric stretch; coupling eps_tilde = lambda*omega, screened by the molecular polarizability (denom = 1 + lambda^2 eps.chi.eps). NEP is recomputed each test run; DeepMD and the ab initio column are cached references. Models are shared with ../../no-polar/mlip/models.
